newsitem.title: USA: Jitney-Jungle says FTC seeks more data on offer.
newsitem.headline: Jitney-Jungle says FTC seeks more data on offer.

text.p: Jitney-Jungle Stores of America Inc said Wednesday it has received a second request from the U.S. Federal Trade Commission for additional information related to its $30-a-share tender offer for Delchamps Inc..
As a result it said it had extended the tender offer to 1700 EDT/2100 GMT on August 25. It was originally scheduled to expire at 2400 EDT August 8/0400 GMT August 9.
It said that as of July 29, 157,572 common shares of Delchamps had been tendered and not withdrawn.

The regional supermarket chain said the waiting period for FTC's clearance of the tender offer under antitrust regulations would expire at 2359 EDT on the 10th calendar day after the date of substantial compliance to the FTC request, unless the waiting period were terminated earlier by the agency.
The tender offer will not be consummated until the waiting period expires, or any other period during which Jitney-Jungle may agree not to purchase Delchamps shares, it added.

Jitney-Jungle said it is proceeding as expeditiously as possible to comply with the FTC's request. It noted, however, that it is possible that a further extension of the offer may be required in connection with the request.
